agents.name: Lead research
agents.desc: Finds businesses that fit you, with the facts that matter (owner, size, city) and the source of every fact.

agents.name: Company research
agents.desc: Fills in a prospect's legal status, GST number, government orders and decision maker - each fact with its source.

agents.name: Outreach and follow-ups
agents.desc: Writes first emails and follow-ups in your voice, and sends them only after approval.

agents.name: Pitch deck maker
agents.desc: A short deck made for each prospect - their problem, your answer, their competitors - ready to send.

agents.name: Call assistant
agents.desc: A card for every call: who to call, what to say, the outcome noted, and the next step booked.

agents.name: Social media posts
agents.desc: Drafts LinkedIn posts from your real work and publishes them after approval.

agents.name: Website articles
agents.desc: Researches and drafts articles for your website, checks they don't repeat old ones, publishes after approval.

agents.name: Email desk
agents.desc: Reads incoming mail, sorts it (customer, supplier, spam), and drafts replies for a person to approve.

agents.name: WhatsApp desk
agents.desc: Answers WhatsApp Business messages with your menu and hands real conversations to a person.

agents.name: Meeting scheduler
agents.desc: Books meetings with a Google Meet link, sends the invite and reminds both sides.

agents.name: Project manager
agents.desc: Plans every project into steps with owners and dates, tracks progress and flags what is running late.

agents.name: Tender desk
agents.desc: Finds government tenders that fit you, checks eligibility, and says which are worth bidding for.

agents.name: Tender reader
agents.desc: Turns a tender's four or five documents into one dossier - every requirement, date and rupee, with its source.

agents.name: Bid costing
agents.desc: Works out what a tender job will cost you and a sensible bid price, line by line.

agents.name: Document reader
agents.desc: Reads long PDFs, scanned papers and spreadsheets and pulls out what you need into one clean sheet.

agents.name: Accounts and invoices
agents.desc: Makes invoices and GST-ready PDFs, keeps the ledger and reminds about payments due.

agents.name: Quotations
agents.desc: Prepares quotations from your price list, tracks which are waiting, and follows up.

agents.name: Website builder
agents.desc: Builds and updates your website, with a private preview before anything goes live.

agents.name: Software builder
agents.desc: Builds small software features and fixes, tested in a sandbox, merged only when a person approves.

agents.name: Security checks
agents.desc: Scans your code for leaked keys and outdated parts, and keeps your DPDP / CERT-In checklist (SKULL.ORG).

agents.name: Health monitor and self-repair
agents.desc: Watches every job in your office, restarts what fails, and tells you what it could not fix.

agents.name: Quality reviewer
agents.desc: Checks every email, post and document before it goes out - wrong names, cut-off text, promises you can't keep.

agents.name: Approval council
agents.desc: Approves the routine decisions you hand it, and sends you only the ones that need you.

agents.name: Approvals and owner dashboard
agents.desc: One place, on your laptop and phone, to see every department's work and approve what needs you.

negotiable: Approximate. The price is negotiable, and it can go up with how heavy the work is: how many people use it, how much it reads, and which of your tools it connects to. We confirm the price after a short call.
